title: Constructibility of proper images for the full continuous algebraic-closure coefficient
statement: For a proper k-morphism p:X to Y of separated finite-type schemes over a positive-characteristic field k with characteristic different from the prime ell, every cohomology object of Rp_* K is constant-model constructible when K is a bounded constant-model constructible finite-Tor complex over the condensed ring C(-,PadicAlgCl ell). All continuous maps into the topological algebraic closure are used. Bounds follow separately from det-sf-comp-continuous-algcl-lower-tail and the right-derived bounded-below comparison, and finite Tor amplitude then follows from det-sf-comp-continuous-algcl-constructible-tor. No coproduct or compactification assertion is made.

source.place: Assertion (1), constructibility of the proper image, as used in the proper-image paragraph of det-sf-comp-coherence-single.

proof.text: For the full continuous-map algebraic-closure coefficient, use the local finite-free theorem proved in ContinuousAlgClLocalFree. Finite constant local models imply local finite presentation by the proved constantModel_lfp helper. Conversely local finite free covers give finite free constant models. Thus constant-model constructibility agrees with stratified local finite presentation on the Noetherian target. The generic Serre argument gives kernel, cokernel and extension closure, including zero and isomorphism invariance.

The output complexes with constructible cohomology form a triangulated replete subcategory by the weak Serre class homology theorem. Its inverse image under the triangulated derived pushforward is triangulated and replete. The separate proper-heart finiteness theorem puts the degree-zero constructible sheaves in it. The bounded Postnikov filtration expresses K as an iterated extension of shifts of its constructible cohomology sheaves. Closure under shifts, isomorphisms and extensions puts K in this inverse image; convert output cohomology back to finite constant models. Bounds and finite Tor amplitude are separate, so no extra geometric assertion is invoked here.

theorem continuousAlgCl_proper_finiteness
    (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime]
    (k : Type u) [Field k] [Fact (ringChar k).Prime] [Fact (ringChar k ≠ ℓ)]
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} [X.Over (Spec (.of k))] [Y.Over (Spec (.of k))]
    [IsSeparated (X ↘ Spec (.of k))] [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (.of k))] [IsSeparated (Y ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y ↘ Spec (.of k))] [QuasiCompact (Y ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    (p : X ⟶ Y) [p.IsOver (Spec (.of k))] [IsProper p]
    (K : ConstantModelConstructibleFiniteTor
      (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj (PadicAlgCl ℓ)) X) :
    ∀ n : ℤ, IsConstantModelConstructible
      (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj (PadicAlgCl ℓ)) Y
      ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ n).obj
        ((lowerStar (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj (PadicAlgCl ℓ)) p).rightDerivedFunctor.obj
          K.obj))
